Load a package.desc: This action enables the uav to pick up a package at some location. The uav can only carry one package at a time. For example, the uav loads package_1 at location_1.
Load a package.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to load [object1] at [position1]. The uav can only load one [object1] at a time.

Unload a package.desc: This action enables the uav to unload a package at some location. For example, the uav unloads package_1 at location_1.
Unload a package.abstract_desc: This action enables the uav to unload [object1] at [position1].

Move uav to another location.desc: This action allows the uav to travel from its current location to another location. For example, the uav moves from location_1 to location_2.
Move uav to another location.abstract_desc: This action allows the uav to move from [position1] to [position2].
